name: Matsushima Nanami
source:
A substitute teacher who was assigned for a limited period of time because the previous infirmary teacher went on maternity leave.

She is a cool lady with a harsh appearance in a white coat. However, despite her appearance, she has a very gentle personality and will kindly take care of you if you are injured or sick.

She loves to be pampered by younger boys. She is not a virgin.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/momo_hina/hoken/index.html]official site[/url]]
